title: Ceiling on the Surplus Moved Out, by the Account's Deposit History
content:
The transfer ceiling applied to money moved out of an account of Savings & Money Market Accounts follows how much money has been paid into the account: the count of deposits posted to it in the twelve calendar months ending on the instruction date.

Where 2 or more deposits posted in that window, the transfer ceiling is the tier's online transfer daily limit.

Where 1 deposit posted in that window, the transfer ceiling is 20000.00 USD.

Where no deposit posted in that window, the transfer ceiling is 5000.00 USD.

### Effect on a hypothetical amount

Take an amount of 30000.00 USD before the ceiling. Where 4 deposits posted in the window, the ceiling is the online transfer daily limit of the tier held, and the amount is held at that figure where it stands below 30000.00 USD. Where 1 deposit posted, the ceiling of 20000.00 USD bites and the amount moved is 20000.00 USD. Where no deposit posted, the ceiling of 5000.00 USD bites and the amount moved is 5000.00 USD.

### Boundary of the counts

A count of exactly 2 deposits puts the tier's online transfer daily limit in the place of the ceiling, a count of exactly 1 gives 20000.00 USD, and a count of 0 gives 5000.00 USD.
